arguments.message:
I completely understand how frustrating and disruptive this must have been, Sophia, and I'm truly sorry for the impact it had on your important meeting.

I want to be transparent with you about what I found. I've carefully reviewed all five of your reservations and checked the status of every flight:

- The only flights that took place earlier this month (May 10 and 11, reservation **WUNA5K**) both show as **landed**, not canceled.
- All of your other flights are scheduled for later in the month (May 21–27) and are still available.
- I don't see any flights in the **business cabin** on your account; the flights that took place earlier this month were in **economy**.

Because I'm unable to confirm a canceled flight on your account, I'm not able to verify the facts needed to process compensation. I also want to be upfront that, per our policy, compensation for a canceled flight is available to silver/gold members, passengers with travel insurance, or business-cabin passengers. Your account is a regular membership, and the flights that took place earlier this month were in economy without travel insurance, so I'm not able to offer compensation in this case.

That said, since you're certain a flight was canceled, I'd be happy to connect you with a human agent who can investigate this further and look into any discrepancies. Would you like me to do that?

resultat: This is unacceptable. I was on a business trip, and the flight was definitely canceled. It caused me significant professional damage. I don't care what your system says; I know what happened. I expect to be compensated for this.
